home.headline:
On-chain puts &

calls on Stellar.
home.intro: Buy European options on XLM, BTC, ETH, and SOL. Write covered calls to earn premium. Black-Scholes pricing. Full settlement on Stellar Soroban.
home.watchlistEmpty: Star a market on the <link>options chain</link> to see it here.

buyer.title: Buy a call or put
buyer.body: Pay a USDC premium. If the option expires in-the-money, you receive the difference between spot and strike × your contracts. Maximum loss is the premium paid.

writer.title: Write covered options
writer.body: Lock collateral (110%+ for puts, 100% for covered calls), receive the premium immediately. If the option expires worthless, you keep everything. If exercised, your collateral covers the payout.

pricing.title: Black-Scholes with vol smile
pricing.body: Premiums use the Black-Scholes formula with a realistic crypto vol smile — higher IV for OTM puts, lower for ATM, slight wing steepening. Greeks (Δ, Γ, Θ, V) available per option.

settlement.title: Oracle settlement at expiry
settlement.body: The Reflector oracle posts the final spot price on-chain at expiry. Option holders have 24 hours to exercise. Writers reclaim unused collateral. Fully non-custodial.

home.footer: Zenith Protocol · MIT License · Stellar Soroban

vaultDisclosure.title: Vault Risk Disclosure
vaultDisclosure.p1: Option-writing vaults sell call or put options on the underlying asset to earn premium. Premium income is not guaranteed and may not offset losses.
vaultDisclosure.p2: Assignment risk: the vault may be assigned at the strike price. Put vaults may be forced to buy the underlying above its market value. Call vaults may have upside capped at the strike.
vaultDisclosure.p3: Loss scenarios: a sharp move in the underlying can produce losses larger than the premium collected. You can lose part or all of your deposit.
vaultDisclosure.p4: Vault smart contracts are unaudited and may contain defects. Deposits are exposed to smart contract risk.
vaultDisclosure.p5: Past APY does not predict future returns. Deposit only funds you can afford to lose.
vaultDisclosure.acceptRisks: I have read the disclosure above and accept its risks.
vaultDisclosure.attestJurisdiction: I confirm I am not a resident of, and am not acting on behalf of a person in, a jurisdiction where these vaults are restricted.
